description: Alpha Agent Stage 9 - persistent Autonomous Alpha Tournament. A disciplined candidate-selection system that continuously generates, evaluates, ranks, rejects, combines and forward-monitors alpha candidates on top of the Stage 5 experiment engine, the Stage 8 durable queue and the forward-prediction immutable snapshot store. RESEARCH ONLY. There is NO automatic PROMOTED state; READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW never modifies the operating model. Never creates orders/fills/signals/trade-decisions/model-promotions/Alpha-Paper-Book changes/Daily-Close/PostgreSQL writes; never runs the prediction service. A candidate is NEVER ranked highly merely because one isolated metric or one test period looks good.

evidence_completeness.note: A candidate can only be REJECTED on complete-and-weak evidence. When coverage/observation/PIT minimums are unmet the candidate is DATA_HOLD (evidence cannot yet be evaluated honestly), never REJECTED.

gates.note: KEEP_FOR_RESEARCH requires ALL of the following on COMPLETE evidence. Complete-but-failing => REJECTED with the specific failed gate. Thresholds are deliberately explicit and versioned; none are invented silently at runtime.

manual_review_gate.note: READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW is the strongest state and still NEVER changes the operating model. It requires historical evidence pass + robustness pass + demonstrable added value beyond the champion and retained candidates + a shadow book with enough true-forward observations + all caveats displayed.

scoring.note: Combined tournament score in [0,1], reproducible and decomposable into six sub-scores. A candidate with excellent gross return but poor cost-adjusted performance or instability CANNOT lead: cost and stability are weighted and a hard cost/stability penalty caps the combined score.

cost.note: cost sub-score falls as cost erodes gross; net25<=0 forces cost sub-score to 0 and caps combined score.

diversification.note: diversification sub-score = 1 - max(|corr vs champion|, |corr vs retained|). High correlation is penalized so a redundant candidate cannot lead.

forward_evidence.note: 0 until a shadow book exists; grows with true-forward observations toward maturity and rewards realized net outperformance.

auto_experiments.note: The tournament autonomously enqueues the next highest-value experiments into the Stage 8 durable queue. Bounded per cycle, deterministically deduplicated by experiment specification hash. Each strategy addresses a real next question; endless re-optimization against one historical sample is forbidden.

shadow_books.note: Read-only research shadow books for the strongest KEEP_FOR_RESEARCH candidates, built on the forward-prediction immutable first-write-wins snapshot store. Never mutate the operating portfolio; never backfill forward history before the shadow book's inception date.
shadow_books.label: RESEARCH SHADOW BOOK - NOT THE OPERATING PORTFOLIO

cycle.note: Per-production-cycle bounded tournament tick integrated into the AlphaAgent-Collect autonomy cycle. Resumable after Windows/process restart; leaves useful future work queued while unresolved candidates remain.

reporting.note: Morning and post-close reports flag ONLY meaningful tournament changes; unchanged leaderboards are never re-sent.

stage9_4.note: Stage 9.4 orthogonal-discovery capabilities the AGENT drives autonomously from its canonical collect tick. When seed_price_catalogue is true the tick idempotently seeds the pre-registered price-factor catalogue; when evaluate_price_catalogue is true the owned-price campaign also computes the NEW factors and enriches each with orthogonality / regime / walk-forward / bootstrap / selection-bias evidence before classify_evidence decides DATA_HOLD/REJECTED/KEEP. No gate is lowered; the INDEPENDENT_INFORMATION sub-score is reported in the decomposition and folded into the combined score only via scoring.weights.independent_information (default absent = 0, operator-tunable).

followups.note: Stage 9.4 release closure: the AGENT autonomously enqueues a BOUNDED, pre-registered price-factor REVALIDATION experiment (a genuine canonical CAT_EXPERIMENT job on the shared durable queue, origin stage9-tournament, lane tournament.stage9_4_revalidation) each cycle, so the generate->claim->execute->persist->ingest loop closes through the production handler even with zero retained candidates. Deterministic, spec-deduplicated and capped: at most max_per_cycle NEW jobs, targeting ONLY computable owned-price catalogue candidates already on COMPLETE evidence (REJECTED), re-running the candidate's OWN registered horizon (a reproduction, not a parameter search). No gate is lowered; no KEEP is forced; nothing operational is mutated. Disabled by default in offline/acceptance configs.

companyfacts_campaign.note: Stage 9.4 release closure DECISION = OPTION B (DEFER HONESTLY). The SEC companyfacts parser (alpha_agent.sec_companyfacts) and the PIT-fundamentals / fundamental-signal modules are retained as INACTIVE, reusable capabilities only. There is NO live companyfacts acquisition wired into the canonical collect tick (no owned companyfacts exist; owned coverage is NOT fabricated). Stage 9.4 is therefore PRICE-FACTOR DISCOVERY plus PIT-FUNDAMENTALS SCAFFOLDING: all fundamental candidates stay DATA_HOLD and the readiness gate (_wg_pit_fundamentals) reports honest owned coverage. The NEXT explicit stage is a live, bounded companyfacts acquisition campaign (Option A) reusing this same controlled-campaign framework. enabled=false keeps the campaign deferred; set true only when a live per-CIK SEC companyfacts fetch is actually wired.

final_holdout.note: A single reserved final out-of-sample window that can be consumed at most once - never re-mined across cycles.
final_holdout.description: reserved final holdout - single-use selection-bias guard
